title: Escalation Routing Rule R-014: Narcotic drug query
content:
ROUTING RULE: R-014 -- Narcotic drug query
TRIGGER TYPE: Drug Schedule
CONDITION: Schedule X or controlled substance query
ROUTE TO: Clinical Review (Extension 1012)
QUEUE: QUEUE_CLINICAL
PRIORITY: URGENT
SLA: 0.5 hour(s)
ESCALATION RATIONALE: Statutory narcotic register compliance and dual sign-off required. Schedule X requires consultant prescription and dual-nurse witnessing. Contact Clinical Review ext. 1012.
EXAMPLE QUERY 1: Need emergency dose of Inj Morphine 10mg
EXAMPLE QUERY 2: How do I request Fentanyl ampoule?
